calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH days AS (SELECT calendar_date, is_trading_day, holiday_name FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
fact AS (SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS store_lines_all_skus, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT business_date, receipts AS rpt_receipts, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns, returns_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'),
ret AS (SELECT r.return_date, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS sku_units_returned FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, fact.store_lines_all_skus, fact.receipts, fact.last_load, rpt.rpt_receipts, rpt.units_sold, rpt.net_sales_before_returns, rpt.returns_net, ret.sku_units_returned
FROM days d LEFT JOIN fact ON fact.sale_date = d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN rpt ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.return_date = d.calendar_date ORDER BY 1

SELECT 101624 AS sku, 'Fixings & Fasteners Raudikko 251' AS product_name, 131 AS store_id, 'Oulu Kaakkuri' AS store_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week = 22
